area-alt-present: Clickable areas of an image map have a name
area-alt-quality: The names of clickable image areas make sense
aria-allowed-attr: Accessibility attributes (ARIA) suit the element they're on
aria-braille-equivalent: Braille labels have an ordinary text label too
aria-checked-state-mismatch: A checkbox says it's ticked only when it is
aria-conditional-attr: An error message is linked only to a field marked as wrong
aria-deprecated-role: Elements don't use outdated accessibility roles
aria-expanded-state-mismatch: A button that opens something says whether it's open
aria-hidden-body: The whole page isn't hidden from screen readers
aria-hidden-focus: Nothing hidden from screen readers can get keyboard focus
aria-owns-valid: Accessibility attributes don't give an element two parents
aria-prohibited-attr: Names aren't given to elements that can't have one
aria-prohibited-children: Grouped controls contain only the parts they allow
aria-required-attr: Interactive elements have the settings their role needs
aria-required-children: Grouped controls contain the parts they need
aria-required-parent: Parts of a grouped control are inside that group
aria-role-name-present: Elements that need a name have one
aria-roles-valid: Accessibility roles are real, valid roles
autocomplete-valid: Form fields use a valid autocomplete value
avoid-inline-spacing: Text spacing can be increased by the reader
binary-control-name-present: Checkboxes and switches have a name
bypass-blocks-present: Visitors can skip past repeated parts of the page
canvas-text-alternative-present: Drawings made with a canvas have a text alternative
canvas-text-alternative-quality: Text alternatives of canvas drawings make sense
click-handler-keyboard-operable: Things that react to a click also work with the keyboard
cms-link-to-document: Links to documents say what they open
contrast-minimum: Text has enough contrast with its background
css-hidden-focus: Things that can get keyboard focus aren't invisible
css-orientation-lock: The page works both upright and sideways
dlitem-parent-valid: Description list items are inside a description list
duplicate-id-aria: IDs that labels refer to are unique
embed-text-alternative-present: Embedded content has a text alternative
embed-text-alternative-quality: Text alternatives of embedded content make sense
focus-not-obscured-minimum: Keyboard focus isn't hidden behind other content
form-control-label-quality: Form field labels are clear and different from each other
form-control-programmatic-label-quality: Form fields have a label you can see
form-control-single-label: Each form field has one label
heading-order: Heading levels don't skip a level
heading-quality: Headings say what the section is about
html-lang-attr-present: The page says what language it's in
html-xml-lang-mismatch: The page doesn't declare two different languages
identical-iframes-same-purpose: Embedded frames with the same name show the same thing
iframe-focusable-content: Content inside a frame can be reached with the keyboard
image-of-text: Text is real text, not a picture of text
image-redundant-alt: Alternative text doesn't repeat the text next to the image
img-alt-decorative: Images marked as decorative really are decorative
input-image-alt-decorative: Image buttons with no text really need none
input-image-alt-quality: Alternative text of image buttons says what they do
invalid-field-error-message: Fields marked as wrong show an error message
label-in-name: A control's name includes the words you see on it
landmark-banner-is-top-level: The site header isn't inside another page region
landmark-complementary-is-top-level: Sidebars aren't inside another page region
landmark-contentinfo-is-top-level: The site footer isn't inside another page region
landmark-main-is-top-level: The main content isn't inside another page region
landmark-no-duplicate-banner: The page has only one site header
landmark-no-duplicate-contentinfo: The page has only one site footer
landmark-no-duplicate-main: The page has only one main content area
landmark-one-main: The page marks its main content
landmark-unique: Page regions of the same kind have different names
link-in-text-block: Links in text stand out by more than their colour
link-name-quality: Link text says where the link goes
link-name-quality-link-only: Link text makes sense on its own
listitem-parent-valid: List items are inside a list
media-alternative-transcript-evidence: Audio and video have a transcript
meta-refresh-timing-absent: The page doesn't reload or redirect on a timer
meta-viewport-large: Visitors can zoom in to five times the size
mouse-only-event-handlers: Things that react to the mouse also work with the keyboard
nested-interactive-controls-absent: Buttons and links aren't inside each other
no-autoplay-audio: Sound that plays by itself can be stopped
object-text-alternative-present: Embedded objects have a text alternative
object-text-alternative-quality: Text alternatives of embedded objects make sense
option-name-present: Options in a list have a name
p-as-heading: Text that looks like a heading is a real heading
page-title-patterns: The page title says what the page is
page-zones-landmark: The header, navigation, search and footer are marked as page regions
presentational-children-focusable-absent: Decorative parts of a control can't get keyboard focus
reflow-horizontal-scroll: The page fits a phone screen without scrolling sideways
region: All content is inside a page region
scrollable-region-focusable: Scrolling areas can be scrolled with the keyboard
server-side-image-map-absent: Clickable images work with the keyboard too
skip-link: The "skip to content" link goes somewhere
spinbutton-name-present: Number fields with up and down arrows have a name
svg-image-text-alternative-present: Images inside graphics have a text alternative
svg-text-alternative-present: Vector graphics (SVG) have a text alternative
svg-text-alternative-quality: Text alternatives of vector graphics make sense
table-duplicate-name: A table's caption and summary don't repeat each other
table-fake-caption: Tables use a real caption, not a first row
table-headers-attr-valid: Table cells point to existing header cells
table-th-has-data-cells: Table header cells describe some data
target-size-minimum: Things to click or tap are big enough, or far enough apart
text-spacing-content-loss: Text stays readable with more spacing
treeitem-name-present: Items in a tree have a name
valid-lang: Language settings on parts of the page are valid
video-poster-text-alternative-present: Video preview images have a text alternative
widget-keyboard-focusable: Controls can be reached with the keyboard
